descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Orion' Dwarf Red 'Orion' Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum 'Orion' is a dwarf red Japanese maple with yellow fall color that was found as a witches' broom by the late Dick Wolff of Red Maple Nursery in Pennsylvania. It has a nice dense habit, reaching 3-4 ft in height by 6-7 ft in width in 15 years. Photos by Ed Shinn, Used with permission.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Orion'，矮生红叶日本枫，适生区 5-9。 Acer palmatum 'Orion' 是一个矮生红叶日本枫品种，秋季转黄色，由宾夕法尼亚州 Red Maple Nursery 已故的 Dick Wolff 作为丛生芽变发现。 株形紧凑致密，15 年可达高 3-4 英尺、宽 6-7 英尺。 照片由 Ed Shinn 拍摄，经授权使用。
